draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 50th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 7th of 20 at DE. He went 31st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Dante Fowler Jr.. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2022, 5th of 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Kansas City Chiefs. 34 career games and 3 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2024. Versus the typical Year-2 edge rusher who played: 2.5 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
